verdict.rationale: Keycloak's user federation (custom providers for existing user stores) and identity brokering/social login allow users to keep authenticating against an external system while migrating, which is the technical mechanism needed to avoid forced password resets, but there is no vendor-maintained guide or tooling specifically targeted at migrating off competing auth providers (e.g., Auth0, Okta) documented in the evidence. missing for 10: dedicated migration guide/tooling for competitor auth providers, documented password-hash import support, case studies of password-reset-free migrations.
